description: Source code for the implementation of CU-UP (CU User Plane) component, managing GTP-U, E1AP, and NG-U sessions, including setup, teardown, and statistics reporting.

classes.name: cu_up
classes.description: Main class implementing CU-UP functionality, managing sessions, timers, and control flow.

methods.name: cu_up
methods.description: Constructor initializing CU-UP with configuration and dependencies, setting up GTP-U, E1AP, and NG-U sessions.

methods.name: cu_up::start
methods.description: Starts CU-UP, establishing connections and initiating setup routines.

methods.name: cu_up::stop
methods.description: Stops CU-UP, tearing down sessions and stopping timers.

methods.name: cu_up::handle_stop_command
methods.description: Handles the stop command asynchronously, stopping timers and CU-UP manager.

methods.name: cu_up::on_statistics_report_timer_expired
methods.description: Logs current statistics and restarts the reporting timer.
